note: Menu Export exports/imports content menu links (menu_link_content entities) via two config objects: menu_export.settings (key 'menus' = array of selected menu machine names) and menu_export.export_data (the serialized links, keyed by link id; each field stored as its first delta, so export_data.<id>.menu_name.value / .title.value). Admin section at /admin/config/development/menu_export (Menu List / Export / Import tabs), all gated by the 'export and import menu links' permission; info.yml has no configure route. KNOWN BUG on Drupal 11: the Drush commands menu_export:export and menu_export:import throw ArgumentCountError because MenuExportDrushCommands does `new MenuExportForm(\Drupal::configFactory())` while D11 ConfigFormBase::__construct needs 2 args; the ADMIN FORMS work (container DI). Because of that, execution cases are grounded in the agent-reachable selection config (menu_export.settings.menus); a medium reads back the export payload (menu_export.export_data) that the Export admin form produces. Setup for that medium replicates MenuExportForm::exportMenus() logic to populate export_data. No config schema shipped, no plugins.

evals.prompt: Core Configuration Management syncs my menus between sites but the actual menu links inside them don't move. How does the menu_export module solve this, and what kind of menu links does it handle?
evals.expected_output: menu_export serializes the content menu links (menu_link_content entities) of selected menus into the menu_export.export_data config object, so they travel with config export/import. It handles content/custom menu links (created in the UI), not module-defined links from *.links.menu.yml.

evals.prompt: Which Drush commands does the menu_export module provide to export and import menu links from the command line?
evals.expected_output: drush menu_export:export (aliases menu-export-export / menu_export-export) writes the selected menus' links to menu_export.export_data; drush menu_export:import (aliases menu-export-import / menu_export-import) recreates/updates them from that config on the target site. Note: on Drupal 11 these CLI commands currently error (ArgumentCountError); the equivalent Export/Import admin tabs work.

evals.prompt: Where is the menu_export admin UI, and what permission controls access to exporting and importing menus?
evals.expected_output: The admin section is at /admin/config/development/menu_export (Menu List, Export, Import tabs). All are gated by the 'export and import menu links' permission. The selected menus are stored in menu_export.settings (menus).

evals.prompt: On this site the menu_export module has been configured to export a particular menu. Inspect the live configuration and state which menu (machine name) is currently selected for export.
evals.expected_output: The selected menu is menuexp_known (menu_export.settings menus: [menuexp_known]).

evals.prompt: The menu_export module on this site has already exported a menu's links into its export data config. Inspect the live menu_export.export_data configuration and report the title of the exported menu link.
evals.expected_output: The exported payload (menu_export.export_data) contains one link titled 'Exported Data Link' (its menu_name is menuexp_data). Each entry stores the field values, e.g. title.value = 'Exported Data Link'.

evals.prompt: This site has a custom menu with machine name 'menuexp_task' that is not yet marked for export. Using the menu_export module, configure it so that this menu will be included when menus are exported. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: menu_export.settings 'menus' now includes 'menuexp_task' (e.g. tick it on the Menu List form at /admin/config/development/menu_export and save, or drush config:set menu_export.settings menus.0 menuexp_task -y).

evals.prompt: This site has two custom menus, 'menuexp_a' and 'menuexp_b'. Using the menu_export module, configure it so that BOTH menus are selected for export. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: menu_export.settings 'menus' contains both 'menuexp_a' and 'menuexp_b' (tick both on the Menu List form and save, or set the menu_export.settings menus array via drush/config to include both).
